title: Planting Trees in the Neighborhood
paragraphs: Noticing how bare and hot the main street in his neighborhood felt during summer afternoons, Faiz proposed a community tree-planting project to his local residents' association last spring.
Some neighbors were skeptical at first, questioning whether anyone would actually maintain the young trees properly once the initial enthusiasm of planting day inevitably faded away.
Faiz organized a simple rotating watering schedule among volunteers, addressing this exact concern directly rather than dismissing it as an unlikely problem that would not actually occur.
Two years later, the young trees now provide real shade along the street, and neighbors who once doubted the project now regularly thank Faiz for pushing the idea forward despite early skepticism.
